༄༅/ /badz+ra bhai ra ba'i las mkhan legs ldan lha'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa'i lag len bzhugs/snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /badz+ra bhai ra ba'i las mkhan legs ldan lha'i mgon po'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa'i lag len bzhugs/

snyan rgyud shin tu gsang ba/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po'i las byed drag po chen po zhes bya ba dbang phyug chen po'i sgrub thabs ni 'di yin te/ 'di ni mu stegs lugs ma yin la/ rnying mar grags pa'i rlung zhags kyi lha dang yang 'di mi 'dra ste/ 'di ni nges don du ye shes pa yin la/ drang don yang lha chen po gsum gyi ya gyal de yin/ cig shos de ni 'di'i 'khor du gtogs pa/ bod khams nyid la gtso bor spyod pa'i dregs pa gdug rtsub can zhig yin par snang bas so/ /'di ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud dang*/ te lo'i rtog pa che chung gnyis la brten pa'i man ngag rwa lo rdo rje grags pa'i zhal gdam yin no/ /te lo'i rtog pa che chung de gnyis kyang 'jigs mdzad chen po'i rgyud rgyas pa'i dum bu yin no/ /'di la rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa ni rang gi mdun du gtor ma spy-i 'gro'i dang*/ da dhu ra'i me tog /me tog dmar po gzhan dang*/ tshil chen/ sha chen/ chang rak+ta/ dug chu'i mchod yon sogs bshams/ dpal 'jigs mdzad chen po'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod gtor rnams yi dam gyi cho ga bzhin du byin gyis brlabs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi thugs ka nas hūṃ gcig spros pa yongs su gyur pa las/ legs ldan lha'i mgon po sku mdog rtsa zhal sngo skya/ zhal lnga g.yas dmar/ rgyab ser/ g.yon dkar/ steng zhal dud kha'o/ /steng zhal lnga po thams cad spyan gsum pa/ phyag bzhi dang po gnyis kyi rtse gsum dang kha ṭaṃ ga / 'og ma gnyis kyis ḍā ma ru dang chang gis gang ba'i shar lho thod pa 'dzin pa/ stag lpags/ mi lpags/ glang lpags/ sbrul dang mgo 'phreng sogs kyis brgyan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gaṅgā dang zla bas brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyangs pas khyu mchog dkar po'i gdan la gnas pa/ g.yon gyi phyogs nas lha mo gau ri dmar mos 'khyud pa'o/

/rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas legs ldan lha'i mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ka pā la mā lā/ a liṃ kri te shwa ra hūṃ hūṃ/ a gats+tsha ya a gats+tsha ya ru dra a swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ sum b+ta 'am a mṛ ta sa bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying po'i mthar sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dam la bzhag / oṃ ma he shwa ra sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha yi rgyal po mthu bo che/ /'jig rten gsum la dbang bsgyur pa/ /drag po mig gsum bde byed de/ /u ma'i bdag po khyod la bstod/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka nas dbang gi lha spros te dbang bskur te rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan/ spyan 'dren gyi sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi zhabs kyu'i nang dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar sngags 'phreng bsam la/ oṃ aḥru dra hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ thun 'jog khar mchod bstod byas te/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa lte ba'i sa bon la bsdu/ 'di la bsnyen pa'i grangs kyi nges pa med pa'i ji ltar bde ba'o/ / las kyi bsnyen pa ni maṇ+ḍal gru gsum spy-i dang ma thun par bshams/ dbus su rtse gsum bris gtor ma nor bu mig gsum sha khrag gis brgyan/ mchod gtor bshams*/ rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa'i skabs ni mkha' 'gro yin/ 'dir shin tu khro bor bsgyur/ sngar gyi bsnyen pas sngags la oṃ a ṇṛ dza sa ma ya/ srog bring bring dza dzaḥ zhes btags pa bzla zhing*/ sngags 'khor thugs kar nas lte bar 'khor ba'i lugs gcig dang*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ gi mdun bskyed kyi sngags 'bras bu'i zhal nas cung zad re blangs te/ rang githugs ka'i sngags la bstim pa'i lugs gcig ste gnyis po spel gyin bzla/ tshul de lta bu'i zhag bdun sogs bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor la nub re bzhin brtan bzhugs bya/ gshegs gsol dang bsdu ba mi dgos/

'di dag gi skabs rnams su/ mahā de ba e dza/ u ma de bī e dza/ dhu pra ma nghu khrag da dun ti ma du dzaḥ zhes pa rbad sngags brgya rtsa re'ang ji ltar 'os pa yang bzla zhing*/ mahā de ba ti dza ti dza/ saṃ bh+ra ma na rak+ṣa kang ka la ya hūṃ/ de ba ra dza ma hā ni dza/ dgra bo mā ra ya thun rbad shaka se na dza dza hūṃ hūṃ/ tsa tur mu kha rak+ṣa ma na/ kang ka la yang hūṃ/ mahā de ba a mu ka mā ra ya sod/ ṇi hur thum dza/ sha trun mā ra ya rbad/ ces pa ni bsad sngags dang thun zor gcig tu dril ba ste/ 'di yang nyer gcig sogs ji ltar 'os par bzla'o/ /de ltar las kyi bsnyen pa 'grol ba'i skabs su mdun bskyed gshegs bsdu byed/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya med kyang*/ tshan po che tsam ma gtogs 'di'i bris 'bur gyi sku brnyan bzhengs pa'i rgyun med do/ / sgrub pa ni sngar gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'dra ba'i mdun du 'brub khung spy-i dang mthun pa dug gis byug pa'i nang du/ grog mkhar bdun dang*/ zag rdzas dang*/ rkang rjes bsres pa'i bag zan kyi ling ga'i snying khar bsad sngags kyis mtha' bskor ba'i bris ling bcug /de dbus su bzhag /ro g.yam gyis kha bcad/ mtshan ngan gnyis su skam thun rlon thun bzhag /rtsib ma'i gzhi dang*/ shug chen kyi mda' la dug khrag gis/ bsad sngags bris pa yang bshams/ de gsum la sogs bsad sngags drug cu re'am mthun mong du drug cu bzlas kyang rung ste thun re bzhin dgos so/ /cho ga ni sngar bshad pa bzhin las/ gtor 'bul gyi skabs spyan 'dren pa'i sngags kyi mthar/ e daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha trun da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa mā ra ya hūṃ phan/ zhes bya/ bzlas pa'i skabs bod rbad gcig tu dril ba dang 'jug tu rbad sngags la bsad sngags btag pa cung zad re bzla/ gtor 'bul song mtshams su 'brub khung kha phye nas liṅga dgug gzhug drag tu bya/ de nas lha dang dbye ba'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa byed/

yid dam gyi phyag mtshan 'debs kha rnams song ba'i rjes su bod rbad bsad gsum gcig tu dril ba'i sngags bzla bzhin du thun gsum po cung zad pa rdeg /bsgrub bya myos shing bcings la thar sa med par bsam/ 'brub khung kha bcad de ri rab kyis kyang mnan par mos/ bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba staṃ bha ya laṃ/ zhes brjod de ltar bsgrubs pas rtags 'byung*/ de nas las la sbyar ba ni/ gzhan snga ma dang 'dra ba las/ mdun bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs su bod rbad bsad gsum gcig tu dril nas bzla/ thun re bzhin ling ga gsar pa re yang bcas/ dgug gzhug lhan cig tu byas/ thun brdegs pa'i bar du 'dra ba las 'brub khung kha bcad de mnan ling ga gsar ba phur skor byas/ phur bas btab ste bsgral nas gtong ma la btab/ gtor sngags kyi 'bul lo/ /mi ring par rtags 'byung zhing*/ ma byung rung zhag bdun sogs song ba na 'brub khung gi ling ga yang phur bus btab/ ral gris gtub nas/ dug shing dam tsher ma can gyi shing la me sbar ba'i nang du tshu tshan ngha ri'i cho ga zhib mo nas 'byung ba ltar sngags bzlas shing*/ thal ba lam rgya gram du mnan par bya'o/ /de nas gtor zor 'phang ba ni 'og tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /'di ni legs ldan lha mgon nyid sgos sgrub kyi tshul yin la/ gsh-in rje'i 'khor lo gtod na de dang sbrel tshul shes dgos so/ / tshu tshun rda ri'i cho ga zhib mo'i lugs ltar sgrub na/ bdag bskyed kyi bzlas pa stong tsam song ba'i mthar/ rang gi snying ga nas raṃ spros pa las nyi ma/ phaṭa spros te de'i steng du 'khor ba las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che'i mig gsum pa/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i dbyug tor gyur/ de las lha chen po sku mdog dmar po'am nag po khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing sbrul gyi tshangs skud can/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing g.yon thod khrag bsnams pa/

zhabs gnyis gyad kyi dor stabs kyis bsgrub bya'i lus la mnan pa zhig sgom/ ye shes spyan 'dren gong du bshad pa dang 'dra/ rang dang pho nya'i thugs kar phaṭa kyi mthar sngags kyi bskor bar bsgom/ oṃ ru dra ma he ṣā ra yo ka pra sha ma ma yo ga sing+nghi da da hi me swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus su bzla/ thun 'jog khar mchod bstod byas la ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bsdu'o/ /'di la gtso bo byed na 'bum phrag bzhi/ de min 'bum tsam bzlas pas/ bsnyen pa yin/ sgrub pa ni de dang 'dra ba las/ rang dang lha chen gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros so/ /bsgrub bya mdun du bkug pa la gtso bo'i zhabs 'og gi gdong brnyan spros shing bsad pa'i las mdzad pa dang*/ lha chen gyis kyang zhabs kyis btegs shing gri gug gis gtubs par bsam la/ hriḥṣ+ti'i mthar hūṃ hāḥd ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ zhes btegs la khri phrag cig bzla bar bya'o/ /las sbyor gi las tshogs 'thor bu ba rnams cho ga zhib mo nyid las gsal/ sbyin sreg gi bsad las ni mchod gtor dang ling ga la tshu tshun ngha ra'i/ sha rus bsre zhing*/ sbyin bsreg 'bul ba'i sngags/ oṃ ru dra nas mi swāhā hūṃ ha/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa ut+te ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma ma hu ya te/ che ge mo/ /mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces bzlas pa'i khyad ma gtogs/ gong rtsa ba'i sgrub thams kyi las sbyor dang 'dra'o/ / 'di ni gshin rje'i 'khor lo sgrub pa'i cho ga dang sbrel te 'khor lo dbang phyug chen po la gtod pa dang*/ 'khrul 'khor sbyin sreg tu byed pa la shin tu bsngags/ sgos su sgrub na'ang 'khyer bde'o/ /'di'i yi ge rnying pa la la na/ tshogs bdag gi gdong can zer ba yod pas/ glang po che'i gdong can dang*/ glang gi gdong can dang*/ ma he'i gdong can tu 'dod pa sogs byung kyang*/ rang lugs khro zhal rang du byed pa ltar 'thad do/ /yang las mkhan te lo'i drag po ba nas 'byung ba ltar bsgrub na/

thog mar nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ rang gi mdun tu bh+ruṃ las dbyug to bh+ruṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las dbang phyug chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mi mgo rlon pas mtshan pa'i dbyug to 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod phrag thugs kar 'dzin pas/ khrag chen dang thal chen gyis lus la byug pa/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis mi ro'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ 'khor srin po pho mo dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan gdug pa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i sngags 'phreng las 'od 'phros/ steng zhal dmar mo'i zhal nas 'thon/ dbang phyug chen po'i spy-i bo'i nas zhugs/ snying kha'i sngags 'khor bskul de'i 'od zer 'khor tshogs la phog pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad dbang du 'dus par bsam/ mahā de bā da ṣa rar/ zha ེ sa pa ci nus bzlas/ thun 'jog khar de nyid mi dmigs par bsgom/ de ltar zhag bdun song nas/ sngar gyi sngags la/ dgra po mā ra ya tsit+ha hur thum/ zhes pa btags te bzla/ yang zhag bdun song ba na sngags de'i ma drug tu yang*/ na maḥb hā bhū ta dgra bo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa btags te bzla/ bdun gsum nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bsnyes pa rdzogs pa yin/ 'di skabs gtor ma sha khrag gis spag shing nor bu mig gsum gyis brgyan pa re bshams/ bzlas pa gang byed pa'i sngags kyis mthar a kā ro btags nas 'bul/ las sbyor nyid la bltos pa'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum ni/ dang por te lo'i khrag dang dug khrag sogs bsres pa'i snag tshas/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud dang bcas pa'i lte bar/ hṛḥṣ+tīḥ sa bskor ba'i dkyil du bsgrub bya'i ming spel/ mā ra ya phaṭa dang bcas pa 'bri/ rtsibs bzhi la yi ge brgyad pa dang dgu pa tshar re/ mu khyud la yi ge bcu gnyis pas bskor/ rtsibs mchan la bsgrub bya 'di zhes bya ba ma he'i shā ras mā ra ya/ zhes pa 'bri/ de yang ling ga'i lus la 'bri ba yin/

de la dgug gzhug dang*/ srab rtsis byas/ te lo'i lpags pa rlid bshus sder mo dang bcas pa mnyes nas phyi nang bsgyur pa'i lpags pa la'ang/ gong gi 'khor lo de 'bri dgos pa yina'ang*/ te'u ma la ngos 'dzin mi gcig pa yod pas/ tshu tshun+dha ra la zer na bod kyi 'di lus chung bas 'khor lo ji bzhin 'bri thub pa dka' 'o/ /nges pa ni tshu tshun ngha ra yin na'ang*/ bod kyi te lor grags pa 'dis de'i dod thub pa/ grub thob kyi dgongs pa yin na dag pa mi gtong ste/ 'di la ni 'khor lo shong ba lhag bcas song bas tshar gnyis bris na legs so/ /gang ltar na'ang rlid bshus kyi nang du bsgrub bya'i bshang lci/ rkang rjes kyi sa/ skra dang*/ pha mes kyi rus pa sogs rdzas gang rnyed kyi dbus su sngar gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa bcug /rlid bshus kyi bskyal ba ro skras bcings/ 'brub khung spyi dang mthun pa'i nang du bcug /drag po'i mchod rdzas spy-i dang mthun pa la te lo sha khrag bsres pa bshams/ 'brub khung gi dbus su bsgrub bya sgyel ba'i steng du legs ldan nyid bsgom/ gzhan gong du bshad pa dang 'dra ba zhag gsum lnga bdun tshun chad byed pa ni las sbyor gyi bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas gzhan 'dra ba las 'brub khung nang g-i ling ga dang*/ rkyal ba'i nang gi bris ling gnyis kar la dmigs nas dgug gzhug yang yang byed cing sngags yig dpyad pa la dgu ba btags/ bcu bdun pa drag tu bzla/ dbang phyug gi zhabs kyis mnan cing*/ dbyug pas brdungs pas myos shing thar pa med par bsam/ zhag chas bya ste las sbyor gyi sgrub pa'o/ /de nas rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar ling ga dang*/ rkyal pa la thun gyis 'debs pa zhag shas byas nas/ gza' skar drag po la ling ga bsgral/ te lo'i sha khrag rus gsum bsres/ thab nang du dbang phyug chen po'i bskyed la sngags 'bru bcu bdun pa la/ bcu gnyis pa btags te sbyin bsreg phul/

'di la sbogs chog dang yang chog gi 'khor lo sogs yod kyang lag len la gcig tu nges par dgos pa'ang min/ sngags kyis rkyal pa 'khor lo dang bcas pa de ka sbyin sreg tu 'bul ba nyid spogs chog yin/ 'di dang gshin rje'i 'khor lo chen mo sbrel lugs kyang shes dgos so/ /da ni 'khor bdag po gshin rje gshed kyi drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sde thung du sbyor bas gtor bzlog gi cho ga ni 'di yin te/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs gang yang rung ba zla gam sngon po'i dkyil 'khor du chos 'byung gru gsum dmar nag de'i dbus su mi ro la dbyug to gnas pa zhig 'bri/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i phyogs su gtor ma nor bu mig gsum gyi gzugs can cig dang*/ mdun du 'phen gtor thog lde'i dbyibs can dug khrag gis byug pa 'god/ drag po'i mchod gtor gyis g.yon skor du bskur/ bsham bkod rnams snga rol nas sdeb gcig la bya/ de'i phyir mchod gtor byin rlabs rgyas pa yang dkyus kyi de kas chog /rtsa ba'i gtor ma bsngo ba'i rjes sam/ drug cu rtsa bzhi phul grub mtshams las kyi gshin rje'i snga phyi gang rung du sbyar kyang rung ste/ 'bru gsum gyis mchod pa byin rlabs kha gsos/ oṃ shu n+ya ta zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin/ de la bzlas pa ni snying po'i sngags thung la/

e a ṇṛ sogs btags/ de la mahā de bā e dza sogs btags pa ste/ bod rbad sbrel pa ci 'os pa bzlas/ de rjes mchod bstod zhig byas nas/ legs ldan lha'i mgon po de nyid las kyi srin po mi bzad pa dbang phyug chen po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mi mgo rlon pas mtshon pa'i dbyug to 'phyar ba nas sogs kyi bskor ba'o/ / mahā de ba de ṣa ra ra dgra bo ma ra ya tsit+ta hur thum/ zhes pa nyid ci mang bzla zhing*/ de la/ mahā de ba te dzo sogs btag go /rkam rlon mda' zer gsum la btab/ drag po'i gtor ma la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug bya ste/ snying po yi ge brgyad pa la/ i daṃ ba ling sogs gong bzhin btag la lan nyer gcig tsam drag tu bzlas/ mchod 'phreng las gshin gyi de 'don pa spos te mchod pa rnams drag gtor la btab/ sngar gyi bstod thung gi mthar/ lha yi rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ /srid pa gsum gyi byed po ste/ /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon lags/ khyod kyis mi thub gang yang med/ /lha min grong khyer sum brtsegs bcom/ /mdung rtse gsum pa gcig bskyod pas/ /sa gzhi chen po ring du 'phangs/ /gdug pa can kun 'joms pa po/ /sgrub po rnal 'byor can rnams la/ /tshe dang blo gros dbang phyug ster/ /nyams pa kun gyi gshed ma mdzad/ khyu mchog rgyal mtshon las la ya/ /dgra bo'i dbug la thum ril li li/ /dgra bo'i mgo la baṃ ril li li/ /dgra bo'i srog la hur thum dzaḥ /dgra bo'i snying la breng shag bh+yoḥ /dam nyams dgra bo phung bar mdzod/ /lha sngags thams cad gshed du phob/ /mdza' bshes gnyen dag 'thab tu chug /dgra bgegs 'khor bcas thal bar rlogs/ khyod kyi 'khor ni mi bsrun te/ /log 'dren bgegs byed bsam mi khyab/ /dgra la ltas ngan cho 'phrul phob/ /god kha sna dgu thong la shor/ /mdangs dang bla tshe phrog la shog /dbang thang longs spyod chom la shog/gtso 'khor grogs gnyen thams cad dkrug

/rgya mtsho'i mtha' dmar bskrod la shog /gling bar mun nag chen por bsgyur/ /lha dang gnod sbyin yi dwags dang*/ /klu dang srin po mi bzad pa/ /ma mo mkha' 'gro drag shul can/ /sde brgyad 'gong po ther 'bum rnams/ /da lta nyid du las la bskul/ /dgra bo'i yul mkhar rmang nas bskyel/ /zhing dang lo tog sad ser chom/ /mi nad phyug nad char ltar phob/ /bdud g.yos ri ltar snyil du chug /bsad skrad dbye dang rings par mdzod/ /mtshon gyi bskal ba der thong zhig /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /thams cad gnod pa'i bgegs la bh+yoḥ /bsam ngan byed kha'i steng du bh+yoḥ /bzlog cig bsgyur cig sa ma ya/ / zhes drag tu bskul lo/ /'di logs su byed pa yin na 'dir ling ga sgrol chog bya/ ling ga la rtse gsum dang mnga'i 'debs pa nges par bya/ gzhan mang nyung ji ltar 'os pa sbyar bas chog /drug cu rtsa bzhi'i lde'u thung la sbyor na ling sgrol dkyus kyi des chog pas/ skabs der dmigs pa gtod kyi 'dir mi dgos so/ /de nas zor 'phang ba ni sngar bzhin bskul nas thog mar skam zor/ de nas rlon zor/ de nas mda' zor/ de nas gtor ma nyid 'phen te/ bsad sngags kho na drag tu bzla'o/ /'di yang drug cu rtsa bzhi'i sngon du 'phang dgos so/ /de nas nang du 'khor nas gtor ma nor bu'i dbyibs de 'thebs kyu gcig gis bsos/ spyan 'dren bsngags la/ a kā ro btags pa tshar gsum gyis phul/ rjes chog rnams dkyus gy-i zhor la 'grub pas logs su mi dgos so/ /zhes pa 'di yang rwa lugs kyi yig rnying gab 'khrugs bsdus shing mi gsal ba rnams gsal byed du/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa ste dpal rdo rje 'jigs mdzad chen po'i las tshogs kyi cha lag tu gal che ba zhig yin no// //maṅga laṃ// dge'o// 'di bris dge bas skyai ba kun tu nges don bstan pa'i mi mthun phyogs thams cad gzhom nus pa'i rgyur gyur cig/
dge legs 'phel// shu bhaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/tā ra nā tha'i gsung thor bu'i skor/ - PAGE 234 -- PAGE 233 -- PAGE 232 -
